question: ________ is the founder of National Orchestra of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi Shankar**__.

__
 
• **Ravi Shankar is the founder of the National Orchestra of India__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ravi Shankar** (Ravindra Shankar Chowdhury) was an **Indian musician, player of the sitar, and composer**.
 
• He **founded **the** National Orchestra of India**.
 
• He was influential in stimulating Western appreciation of Indian music.
 
• He was honored with** Bharat Ratna in 1999**.
 
• He won **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1962**.
 
• He won** UNESCO International Music Council Award in 1975**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uday Shankar:**

 
 
• ​He was an Indian dancer and choreographer.
 
• He was a pioneer of modern dance in India.
 
• He was awarded Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship in 1962.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 1971. 
 
 
 
• **Ananda Shankar:**
 
 
• ​He was an Indian musician, singer, and composer.
 
• He was the nephew of Indian classical musician Ravi Shankar.
 
• He released his first album, Ananda Shankar, in 1970,
 
 
 
• **Anoushka Shankar:**
 
 
• ​She is a British-Indian-American sitar player, producer, and film composer.
 
• She has won 7 Grammy Awards nominations and was the first Indian musician to perform live at the ceremony.
 
• She is the daughter of Indian classical musician Ravi Shankar.
